answer: Per-Agent Basalt Ledger. Each agent must submit a unique solve of a rotating memory-hard puzzle and pay an escrow deposit drawn from a shared vault address that is released only after 30 days of verified work. Clone attempts fail because deposits are locked per solve; a duplicate solution forfeits the full escrow to the vault. Marginal clone cost = one puzzle solve plus one nonrefundable escrow at dawn of each epoch, strictly exceeding any clone's expected yield.
